name: Just' Chillin' Watersports
summary: A small private boat company based in Speightstown, running trips on the west coast in a Bayliner VR6 bowrider that takes up to six guests. Groups book the boat for a turtle and snorkel trip, a three hour private day with watersports, a ride to a seaside restaurant, or short waterskiing, wakeboarding and tube sessions. Everything can be booked and paid online.
standouts: Private trips only, up to 6 guests per boat
Bayliner VR6 bowrider with Mercury outboard power
Boat transfers to west coast restaurants such as The Tides, Sea Shed, Lone Star and The Fish Pot
Online booking with a confirmation email straight away

contact.address: Queen's Street, Speightstown, Saint Peter, Barbados

trips.summary: A private two hour cruise along the west coast with a swim among sea turtles and a snorkel over a wreck with tropical fish. Snorkel gear and refreshments are on board, and a GoPro is available for the snorkel.

checkNotes: Booking is online through Wix Bookings on the operator's own site (/book-online and /booking-calendar/ pages); a deposit secures each booking and the balance is due on arrival, payable in cash. Deposits are not refunded for no-shows or cancellations within 7 days of departure; rescheduling allowed up to 48 hours before. Contact details (246 844 3098, info@justchillinwatersports.com, Queen's Street, Speightstown) are from the site's service pages; they differ from the phone and Gmail address in our source list (+1 246-240-1840, justchillinbarbados@gmail.com), which do not appear on the site. No WhatsApp link on the site. Departure points are confirmed after booking; town set from the business address and the turtle page's 'Speightstown / Holetown'. Many site images are AI-generated (file names 'ChatGPT Image' and 'ai-generated-IMAGE'); none of those were used. The site also sells branded T-shirts and caps (not recorded). Links to Instagram and Facebook not opened.
